package ap

// ddsonic contract helper for patch 0002. Like ap_helper.go.txt, this file
// exists only in the overlay the contract runner builds over the staged
// active tree; it is in no real copy of the SDK and in no ddsonic build. It
// names what patch 0002 adds, so it is never compiled into the base.

import (
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// ddsonicStage is the test's publication stage hook. The package's hook is
// set once, here, before any access point exists, so no test writes it while
// a publication may read it.
var ddsonicStage atomic.Pointer[func()]

func init() {
	testHookStageAfterAnnounce = func() {
		if f := ddsonicStage.Load(); f != nil {
			(*f)()
		}
	}
}

// DDSonicSetStageAfterAnnounce runs f in every publication from now on,
// after the announcement and before the new generation is stored, until
// restore is called.
func DDSonicSetStageAfterAnnounce(f func()) (restore func()) {
	ddsonicStage.Store(&f)
	return func() { ddsonicStage.Store(nil) }
}

// DDSonicStackHas reports whether some goroutine's stack holds every one of
// parts.
func DDSonicStackHas(parts ...string) bool {
	buf := make([]byte, 8<<20)
	for _, g := range strings.Split(string(buf[:runtime.Stack(buf, true)]), "\n\n") {
		all := true
		for _, part := range parts {
			if !strings.Contains(g, part) {
				all = false
				break
			}
		}
		if all {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// DDSonicDeliveryWaiting reports whether an access point's receive loop is
// parked in its delivery to a subscriber, the one blocking select in that
// loop. One access point is live at a time in these tests.
func DDSonicDeliveryWaiting() bool {
	buf := make([]byte, 8<<20)
	for _, g := range strings.Split(string(buf[:runtime.Stack(buf, true)]), "\n\n") {
		head, _, _ := strings.Cut(g, "\n")
		if strings.Contains(head, "[select") && strings.Contains(g, "ap.(*Accesspoint).recvLoop(") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
